trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: I am studying Kant since January.
trap.right: I have been studying Kant since January.
trap.why: O português usa o presente (“estudo desde janeiro”); em inglês, ação que continua até agora pede present perfect continuous.

opts: What strikes me is how modern he sounds.

fix.right: I have been reading this essay since Monday.

fix.right: She has been waiting for an hour.

rewrite.prompt: Present perfect continuous: “I read Hume since March.”
rewrite.answer: I have been reading Hume since March.
What impresses me is his clarity.
